en.name: Marching in place
en.subtitle: Teacher-marked movement · Primary 1–3
steps: Stand with space around you and look ahead.
Lift one foot a little and let the opposite arm swing naturally.
Put the foot down gently and return to both feet.
Lift the other foot and continue alternating at your teacher’s pace, without hopping.
en.focus: Teacher marks each foot lift and return; practise a steady alternating rhythm.

zh-Hant.name: 原地踏步
zh-Hant.subtitle: 老師記錄動作 · 小一至小三
steps: 站在有足夠空間的位置，眼望前方。
輕輕提起一隻腳，另一邊手臂自然擺動。
輕輕放下腳，回到雙腳站立。
換另一隻腳，跟著老師的速度交替踏步，不要跳躍。
zh-Hant.focus: 老師把每次提腳及放下記作一次，留意交替踏步的節奏。
